summary: Eco Wave Power Global AB (publ) furnished a Form 6-K disclosing a press release dated November 5, 2026, announcing that its wholly owned subsidiary Eco Wave Power U.S. Inc. entered a three-year Memorandum of Understanding with WISeQey Corp., SEALSQ Corp. and SEALCOIN AG. The parties demonstrated a trusted digital twin and authenticated automated transactions at the company's Jaffa Port, Israel wave-energy installation, targeting AI data centers and industrial energy buyers. No price, stake, premium or consideration was disclosed; the MoU is non-binding and exploratory. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for conversion into binding commercial agreements.
